A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Lie Symmetry Net. Their complete main texts, appendices, equations, tables and figures are readable and support reliable comparison despite substantial reorganization and formatting changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original numerical experiments on Black-Scholes and Vašiček equations, including approximation and conservation errors in Section 5, Table 2 and Figures 2–9.

after.justification: v2 retains original Black-Scholes experiments in Section 5 and Vašiček operator-combination experiments in Appendix A.4, with numerical and graphical results.

M1.justification: The conservation residual, Lie symmetry risk and four-term weighted training objective are retained. The same Black-Scholes and Vašiček operators remain available; moving Vašiček material to the appendix does not change the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Black-Scholes European-call pricing and Vašiček bond pricing with the same domains and parameter scenarios. The Vašiček experiment moves from Section 5.3 to Appendix A.4.

E2.justification: PINNs, IPINNs, sfPINNs, ffPINNs and LPS remain in their corresponding comparisons. LPS was already evaluated in v1, including comparisons before and after tuning its loss weights.

E3.justification: Table 1 revises reported loss weights. For r=0.1 and σ=0.5, small-set λ1 changes from 0.0001 to 0.001, while small/enlarged-set λ4 changes from 1(1) to 10(0.01). For r=0.11 and σ=0.4, λ4 changes from 10(0.1) to 1(1). Sample counts, training budgets, architectures and metrics remain unchanged; these revisions do not establish rerunning.

E4.justification: The check that LSN's conservation advantage persists after tuning LPS receives revised evidence in Figure 8's lower-middle and lower-right panels. The Figure 7 weight-sensitivity sweeps and Figure 9 single-versus-combined Vašiček operator analysis remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports empirical repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, standard deviations or significance tests. The added plot markers do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Figure 8 replaces conservation-error traces for (r,σ)=(0.1,0.5) and (0.11,0.4), changing their reported levels and trends. Table 2, relative-error curves and Vašiček results remain unchanged. Given the revised reported weights, these replacements do not establish a same-setting performance improvement.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, conservation-law derivations, approximation bounds, generalization bounds and proofs are retained. Feynman-Kac becomes Definition A.5, and the theoretical analysis moves from Appendix A.3 to A.5 without substantive theoretical development.

C1.justification: The central claims remain conservation-based symmetry preservation through structural risk minimization and substantial error reductions over existing solvers. Removing Vašiček from the abstract's examples does not remove its retained methodological and empirical coverage.

C2.justification: The introduction removes speculation that abstract symmetries could reveal 'new economics' and replaces the description of 'mathematically wrong' learned solutions with discussion of structural-constraint violations and uncertain generalization. Experimental interpretations and broader applicability claims largely remain.

D1.justification: The abstract's embedded code link changes from GitHub to an anonymous.4open.science repository. The general Vašiček parameter disclosure, including λ=0.7, is omitted; the experiment-specific settings otherwise remain in Appendix A.4. Neither link's accessibility was tested.

R1.justification: Section 2 substantially expands positioning through new discussions of input-space symmetries, parameter-space symmetries and classical Lie analysis, alongside broader neural-operator coverage. Added citations include Satorras et al., Zhao et al. and Ziyin. The distinction from LPS was already present.

P1.justification: The related-work narrative is extensively expanded and reorganized, and terminology is revised throughout toward 'collocation data' and 'Lie symmetries.' Feynman-Kac and substantial Vašiček background, operator and experimental material move into reorganized appendices. The author list also changes.

P2.justification: The document adopts a different template, title block, typography and page layout. Figures 3, 4 and 6–8 are redrawn with new colors, markers and tick formatting; several labels and captions are corrected. Figure 3's duplicated conservation panel is replaced with content already represented in Figure 6, and Figure 9 moves to the appendix.

improvement.justification: v2 improves research positioning and repairs conservation-error displays, making the retained PINN/LSN controls consistent across Figures 3, 6 and 8. These provide limited gains in clarity and internal consistency while retaining the central method, accuracy evidence and proofs. The gains are tempered by unexplained Table 1 weight revisions and the loss of the previously disclosed Vašiček λ=0.7 setting.
